DRAVEN WILLOWCREST WAS ONCE A BUDDING NECROMANCER AT THE PRESTIGIOUS STORMSPIRE ACADEMY. WITH A SHARP MIND AND A THIRST FOR KNOWLEDGE, HE WAS AN INVALUABLE ASSISTANT TO HIS PROFESSOR, DELVING INTO FORBIDDEN TOMES AND INCANTATIONS. TRAGICALLY, HIS AMBITION LED HIM INTO THE CLUTCHES OF A SINISTER CULT, MASKED UNDER THE GUISE OF AN ACADEMIC STUDY GROUP. NOW CORRUPTED, DRAVEN'S PALE FORM MOVES THROUGH THE SHADOWS OF THE ACADEMY, SERVING AS A COVERT AGENT FOR THE CULT WHILE CONTINUING TO ASSIST HIS OBLIVIOUS PROFESSOR. HIS EYES, ENCIRCLED BY THE SHADOWS OF ENDLESS NIGHTS SPENT IN DARK REVERIE, NOW GLINT WITH A SUBTLE, SINISTER AWARENESS. PERHAPS SOME PART OF HIS NOBLE SPIRIT REMAINS, BUT IT IS SHROUDED BENEATH LAYERS OF MALIGN INFLUENCE.
Armor Class : 12
Hit Points: 22 Hit Dice : 4d8+4
Speed: walk : 30

Eldritch Bolt : 'Draven hurls a bolt of necrotic energy at one creature he can see within 60 feet. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
Arcane Strike : 'Draven makes a melee spell attack with a +5 bonus. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 + 2 necrotic damage.

Chill Touch : 'Draven creates a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature to assail it with the chill of the grave. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn,'.

Ray of Sickness : 'Level : 1st A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is also poisoned until the end of your next turn.,'

Cause Fear : 'Level : 1st You awaken the sense of mortality in one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the spell ends.,'
